lines.beaver: 어머, 이게 얼마 만이야? 정말 반갑다!
lines.beaver_en: Oh my, how long has it been? So good to see you!
lines.beaver_roman: Eomeo, ige eolma maniya? Jeongmal bangapda!
lines.learner: 이모, 오 년 만에 뵈어요. 잘 지내셨어요?
lines.en: Auntie, I'm seeing you after five years. How have you been?
lines.roman: Imo, o nyeon mane boeoyo. Jal jinaesyeosseoyo?

lines.beaver: 그럼. 집에 별일 없지? 엄마는 잘 계셔?
lines.beaver_en: Of course. All well at home? How's your mom?
lines.beaver_roman: Geureom. Jibe byeollil eopji? Eommaneun jal gyesyeo?
lines.en: Yes, Mom visited Grandma's house last week.

lines.beaver: 그래. 너희 언니 수진이는 잘 지내?
lines.beaver_en: I see. How's your sister Sujin doing?
lines.beaver_roman: Geurae. Neohui eonni sujinineun jal jinae?
lines.learner: 언니는 결혼 삼 년 만에 임신했어요.
lines.en: My sister got pregnant after three years of marriage.
lines.roman: Eonnineun gyeolhon sam nyeon mane imsinhaesseoyo.

lines.beaver_en: Really? Congratulations! When is the baby due?
Already? Her in-laws must be happy too.
lines.en: Yes, her in-laws treasure her like their own daughter.

lines.beaver_en: Where will she rest after giving birth?
lines.learner: 출산 후에는 저희 집에서 쉴 거예요.
lines.en: After the birth, she'll rest at our house.
lines.roman: Chulsan hueneun jeohui jibeseo swil geoyeyo.

lines.beaver_en: Good. How's your brother Minho these days?
lines.en: My brother is the eldest son, so he took over Dad's shop.

lines.beaver_en: Your uncle loved Minho like his own son, you know.
lines.en: Yes, and my brother looks up to him like his own father.

lines.learner: 외삼촌 큰아들 지훈이가 다음 달에 결혼해요.
lines.en: Uncle's eldest son Jihun is getting married next month.
lines.roman: Oesamchon keunadeul jihuniga daeum dare gyeolhonhaeyo.

lines.beaver: 몰랐네! 오늘 소식 많이 들어서 좋다.
lines.beaver_en: I didn't know! So nice to hear all this news.
lines.beaver_roman: Mollanne! Oneul sosik mani deureoseo jota.
lines.learner: 이모는 저한테 친어머니 같아요. 자주 연락드릴게요.
lines.en: You're like a mother to me. I'll keep in touch.
lines.roman: Imoneun jeohante chineomeoni gatayo. Jaju yeollakdeurilgeyo.
